name: Duke DI
author: matheusbrasil
description: BOM-first Nobelium/Noble 12AU7 preamp: interactive passive Bass/Trble, physical C8/R18 ROLLOFF, and the complete V2 White-follower 1/4-inch output path.

params.name: Input
params.explanation: Virtual source level into V1B. 50 is the calibrated nominal instrument level; lower values suit quieter sources, higher values emulate a hotter active bass or stronger attack. This is not a physical Nobelium panel control.

params.name: Bass
params.explanation: Boost-only low shelf from the Nobelium BASS A250k control. 0 is the manual's flat reference; its travel is calibrated to measured Noble captures, so 50 corresponds to the physical noon response rather than an arbitrary digital midpoint.

params.name: Trble
params.explanation: Boost-only high shelf from the Nobelium TREBLE A250k control. 0 is the manual's flat reference; higher values add presence and interact with Bass.

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Output trim for the Nobelium 1/4-inch VOLUME path. 80 is unity, 100 is +3.5 dB.

params.name: LoCut
params.explanation: Physical Nobelium ROLLOFF network: C8 4n7 and R18 220k, solved together with the interactive tone stack.
